author: AlfynZack
quote: GTA 6 is a letdown for me. Though its open world looks stunning, the main story is deeply disappointing. The two leads lack sharp chemistry, the plot feels unfocused and drags with tedious filler scenes. Big heist moments are few and lack tension, with weak payoffs. After such a long wait, the writing feels safe and bland, missing the sharp, chaotic edge that made older GTA stories memorable. It’s pretty to look at, yet hollow at its score
